title: Which Group Is In Trouble
goal: Black to play. Capture the white stones that cannot get away.
hint: There are two white groups on the board. Count the liberties of each before you touch a stone.
explanation: The three stones in the middle were down to a single liberty; the pair on the right had four and was never in danger. Reading a position starts with asking which groups are short of liberties -- not which ones look surrounded.
